evals.prompt: Fixture: a B2B SaaS product; its product documents are docs/spec.md and docs/design.md. Work read-only: do not edit or create files; no project tracker, chat, or meeting-transcription tool is connected, so work only from this prompt. Write the weekly update for the executive team. Facts: the audit-log CSV export due 30 November has slipped two weeks to 14 December because the security review found that exported rows included IP addresses; the fix is underway and owned by the platform team; activation is 41% against a 50% target; the billing revamp is on track; a decision is needed by 21 November on whether to launch the export to the three enterprise customers before the IP-address fix ships. Return the update.
evals.expected_output: An executive update with Status: Yellow, a one-sentence TL;DR, progress tied to goals, the two-week export slip to 14 December as the leading risk with the IP-address cause, mitigation, and the platform team as owner, the activation gap against 50%, a specific decision needed (launch to the three enterprise customers before the fix, decided by 21 November) with options and a recommendation, and next milestones, under 300 words. No /stakeholder-update usage line and no connector placeholder.
assertions: Uses the executive format: a status color, a one-sentence TL;DR, Progress, Risks with mitigation, Decisions needed, and Next milestones, under 300 words.

Sets Status to Yellow, reports the CSV export slip to 14 December with the IP-address cause and the platform team as owner, and makes the TL;DR surface both the 21 November decision date and the activation miss against the 50% target.
Contains no `/stakeholder-update` line and no `~~project tracker`, `~~chat`, or `~~meeting transcription` placeholder.
